name: Hygon Information Technology Co., Ltd.
blurb: Hygon Information Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese semiconductor company founded in 2014 that designs high-performance processors, accelerators, and computing chip products for data centers, cloud computing, AI workloads, scientific computing, and industrial applications. The company offers a range of domestic x86-compatible processors targeting data center, mid-range enterprise, and workstation segments, positioning itself as a key domestic alternative amid China's push for semiconductor self-sufficiency. With roughly 3,333 employees and trailing revenue of ~16 billion CNY, Hygon has grown into one of China's most prominent chip designers with a market capitalization exceeding 800 billion CNY.
recent: As of May 14, 2026, shares closed at 325.20 CNY, down 6.60% on the day after trading as high as 358.80 over the prior 52 weeks, reflecting a 126% gain over the past year. The stock has pulled back from recent highs near 358.80 CNY, with elevated RSI of ~72 suggesting overbought conditions after a strong run. The next earnings date is slated for August 10, 2026; trailing twelve-month revenue grew ~60.6% year-over-year and net income rose ~26.9%, underscoring robust demand for domestic Chinese compute infrastructure.
